intro: A sample walkthrough for Harbor Desk, a fictional appointment tool.

steps.title: Set availability
steps.body: Harbor Desk shows visitors the times your team has set aside for appointments.

steps.title: Collect the request
steps.body: A visitor picks a time and leaves an email for a reply. Your receptionist can see the request before confirming it.

steps.title: Review follow-ups
steps.body: The team sees confirmed appointments and open questions in one place. Try both with synthetic contacts in the CallFreya reception workspace.
